verdict.rationale: Retell docs explicitly document a Transfer Call tool supporting cold, warm, and agentic warm transfer modes to route calls to a human (retell-docs-63), and function-calling documentation confirms 'transfer calls' as a core supported action (retell-docs-5, retell-docs-35). This directly covers escalation to a human with warm/blind (cold) transfer, though evidence doesn't detail specifically how much context/data is passed along beyond the transfer mechanism itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of context-passing fidelity during transfer, and more detail on what metadata is conveyed to the human agent.
